pages.text: The gathering facility that produces elements. Wizards automatically come to nodes to gather and send elements into the warehouse.

The town has $(bold)7 elements$(): $(bold)Earth / Wood / Water / Fire / Metal / Wind / Dark$(). Each element has a matching node building (Fire Node, Dark Node, etc.), and $(bold)each type of node produces one fixed element$().
pages.title: Elements & Nodes

pages.text: Place a node → $(bold)aim your crosshair at it and right-click$() to open the panel:$(br2)$(li)The panel shows what this node produces, how much each harvest yields, and how long the channel takes.$(li)The slider sets the $(bold)harvest count$() (1~10), and the panel calculates the total output.$(li)Click $(bold)Publish Gather$(), and a wizard comes to channel. $(bold)The bigger the count, the longer the channel$(), and the more you get at once.$(li)The task queue on the right shows who is gathering, and lets you cancel or reorder.
pages.title: Using It

pages.text: $(li)A node publishes a gather task automatically once built; when the warehouse's elements fall below daily consumption, the system automatically $(bold)adds high-priority gather tasks$() to restock.$(li)Gathers go into the $(bold)warehouse$() — check the stock in the $(l:wandscape:building/warehouse_guide)Warehouse Panel$(/l).$(li)Short on an element? Build more of the matching node; in a hurry, decompose at the $(l:wandscape:building/workstation_guide)Workstation$(/l).$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/warehouse_guide)Warehouse & Materials$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/workstation_guide)Workstation (Decompose & Synthesize)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:start/getting_started_guide)Getting Started: From Empty Land to a Tourist Town$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
